name: NovaBank – AI Customer Support Intelligence
tagline: AI-powered customer support intelligence for a retail-banking case study
description: A DistilBERT intent classifier fine-tuned to 90.59% F1, an XGBoost SLA-breach predictor achieving 77.98% recall with SHAP explainability, and a Gemini-powered RAG pipeline over ChromaDB for grounded resolution recommendations.
